claims.evidence: Witness report only describes a washing machine in a photo; location (Abulegba) is not shown.
Witness: photo 0 shows a white top-loading washing machine with a front label reading “NEXUS”.

risks.risk: Exact model/series and capacity are unknown, which affects value and parts availability.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/series plate or sticker (usually near the door/lid frame or back panel) showing model number and capacity (kg).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity NEXUS top-loader with limited documentation/parts certainty.

risks.risk: Working condition is unverified (no proof of wash/spin/heating).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing a full cycle: power on, selecting wash/spin, drum turning/spinning, and (if applicable) water heating or at least stable operation to completion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Potential leaks, rust, dents, or worn hoses/feet could require immediate repair.
risks.proof: Photos of: (1) bottom/front for leaks, (2) back for hose connections, (3) drum area/lid seal, (4) feet/rubber condition, (5) any rust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible cosmetic/maintenance issues until leak/condition is confirmed.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (inlet/outlet hoses, drain hose, manual/warranty).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included items laid out (hoses, drain pipe, power cable condition, manual/warranty if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain accessories (buyer may need to replace).

risks.risk: Electrical specs (voltage/power rating) and compatibility are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate showing voltage (e.g., 220–240V) and power rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard but unverified electrical compatibility until the rating plate is read.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the model/series sticker/plate (model number and capacity in kg).
Send a short video of the machine running: power on, selecting a cycle, drum agitation/spin, and finishing the cycle without error.
Send photos of the bottom/front for any leaks, plus back-panel hose connections and the lid/rubber seal condition.
Confirm what accessories are included by photographing inlet hose, drain hose, and any manual/warranty documents.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a NEXUS washing machine, but key value drivers (exact model/capacity and confirmed working condition) are not readable or shown. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
